W.note: Restrained lavender halo and a pale sheen with a crisp 170ms leave, well-tuned custom curves and reduced motion, but the hero leaves the right half empty and the dial panel dominates the page.

X.note: The most complete website: a violet-to-sky gradient that shifts and sheens on hover, a bloom on press and a real pricing layout, though the 700ms lift and 1200ms background shift are slow and the buttons rely on heavy box-shadow and background-position transitions.

Y.note: Pastel mint, peach and lavender glow that blooms after a 60ms delay, with a live contrast readout, a curve plotter, a focus ring and reduced motion that keeps the glow, all in an editorial serif layout.

Z.note: The dark violet glow and light sweep feel atmospheric, but both transitions run a slow 560ms, reduced motion strips all hover feedback, press feedback is missing on touch, and the music-player framing is off-brief for a website button.
